summary: Cel Sci Corp filed an 8-K reporting a placement agency agreement with ThinkEquity LLC for the sale of 2.5 million common shares at $1.00 per share, raising $2.5 million in gross proceeds. The offering closed June 16, 2026, under an existing effective S-3 shelf. The company will pay a 7% cash fee and reimburse expenses up to $67k. Directors and officers are subject to 45-day lock-ups; the company has a 30-day issuance blackout. Net proceeds will fund development of Multikine and general corporate purposes. This is a routine at-the-market or direct shelf takedown, not a transformative special situation.
